ruleDefinitions.name: Schtasks From Suspicious Folders
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects scheduled task creations that have suspicious action command and folder combinations

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "schtasks\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pwsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/r\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/r\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%ProgramData\\%.*")))
